title: SynStream - Faisal: Ingestion & Windowing Health
description: Faisal - replay, causal preprocessing, normalization, window progression and shared sink health.

list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query: from(bucket: "synstream_bucket") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_window" and r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r.stream_type == "real" and r._field == "value") |> keep(columns: ["sensor"]) |> group() |> distinct(column: "sensor")

options.content:
**Owner: Inayat Muhammad Faisal** | Pipelines 1 & 2

Historical files -> Kafka replay -> causal imputation -> running Z-score scaling (clipped to +/-4) -> Flink windows. Default configuration: **24 observations, slide 4** (24 hours for UCI; 24 seconds for HAI). These dimensions describe configuration, not measured runtime values.

Dataset/sensor panels use the selectors. Shared sink-health panels cover **all datasets** because `stream_health` has no dataset tag. Times are **sink arrival times**, not original recording time; raw and window curves are not point-aligned. Only the last four rows of overlapping windows are stored. Auto-refresh: **5 seconds**. Data stops advancing when replay finishes; select the run interval for historical review.

panels.title: 1 - Raw replay: ${sensor}
panels.description: Source values as stored before Flink imputation. UCI -200 is a missing-value sentinel; it is deliberately visible here.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_readings" and r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r._field == "${sensor}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 2 - After causal imputation: ${sensor}
panels.description: Real-window values in original units. Compare behavior with the raw panel; arrival times differ, so this is not a pointwise error comparison.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_window" and r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r._field == "value_raw")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_type == "real" and r.sensor == "${sensor}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 3 - Running Z-score and +/-4 clipping
panels.description: Real-window normalized values. Each observation uses running statistics at arrival, not the fixed generator training scaler.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_window" and r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_type == "real" and r.sensor == "${sensor}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 4 - Selected sensor: missing sentinel share
panels.description: Percentage of stored raw values <= -199 in each chart interval. Matches the imputer sentinel rule; does not count records never stored or missing fields.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_readings" and r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r._field == "${sensor}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if float(v: r._value) <= -199.0 then 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 5 - Window progression
panels.description: Maximum window ID per interval for the selected sensor. IDs restart at zero after a Flink restart; this is not a persistent global count.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_window" and r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r._field == "window_id")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_type == "real" and r.sensor == "${sensor}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 6 - Latest replay sequence ID
panels.description: Last stored raw sequence ID for the selected dataset. Starts at zero after replay restarts; not a count across all runs.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_readings" and r.dataset == "${dataset}" and r._field == "sequence_id")
  |> last()

panels.title: 7 - Shared sink throughput by Kafka topic
panels.description: Messages observed by the sink per second across all datasets. This is sink processing throughput, not a measured producer rate.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health" and r._field == "throughput")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 8 - Shared sink lag by Kafka topic
panels.description: Reported Kafka end offset minus consumer position across assigned partitions. Client buffering means this is not an exact count of database writes outstanding.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health" and r._field == "consumer_lag")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 9 - Shared sink nonfinite/null values
panels.description: Counts per health interval across all datasets. Existing monitor counts null/nonfinite values, but does not include the numeric -200 sentinel.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health" and r._field == "missing_values")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 10 - Shared sink backward timestamps
panels.description: Messages older than the largest source timestamp seen for their topic. Replays and switching datasets can trigger this; it is not wall-clock latency.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health" and r._field == "late_timestamps")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
